Reading and study resources

Core texts, preparation, and reference courses for dynamic programming and reinforcement learning.

Core reading

DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING

Dynamic Programming and Optimal Control, Volume I

Dimitri P. Bertsekas

Modeling, the principle of optimality, and classical DP.

Author's book page →

REINFORCEMENT LEARNING

Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction, 2nd edition

Richard S. Sutton and Andrew G. Barto

Learning from experience, value functions, and policy optimization.

Official book page →

THEORY AND EXPLORATION

Reinforcement Learning: Theory and Algorithms

Alekh Agarwal, Kianté Brantley, Nan Jiang, Sham M. Kakade, and Wen Sun

Bandits, exploration, and regret analysis.

Authors' website and free PDF →
